$comment: Every family-facing string. Keys are shared with es.json; a key here with no partner there is a bug caught by the i18n test.

app.title: Family Math Fluency
app.tagline: Five minutes a day. No accounts, no names.

profiles.nicknameHint: Any name you like. It stays on this phone.
profiles.classCodeHint: Your teacher will tell you this.
profiles.studentNumberHint: Your teacher's list number. Not your name.
profiles.removeConfirm: Remove this practiser and their progress from this phone?
profiles.privacyNote: No names or emails are ever sent anywhere. Everything stays on this phone.

practice.question: Question {n} of {total}
practice.quitConfirm: Stop this set? Your answers so far are saved.

procedure.title: Work it out step by step
procedure.estimatePrompt: First, about how many? Round {divisor} to {rounded}.

check.title: Friday Check
check.intro: 20 questions. Take your time — there is no timer.
check.badgeNotYet: Not quite yet — and that is fine
check.focusSpeed: You know these. Next week, work on doing them quickly.
check.focusAccuracy: Keep practising these facts. You are getting closer.
check.sendBody: This code has no name in it — just your class code and list number.

settings.title: Settings
settings.reducedMotionHint: Turns off movement across the app.
settings.timerHint: Off by default. Turn it on only if racing the clock is fun for you.

family.title: How to help this week
family.okYourWay: It is OK if you do it your way
family.okYourWayBody: If you learned a different method, please show it. Children who see two methods that agree understand both better. The method here is the one being taught at school, not the only right one.

teacher.title: Teacher view
teacher.subtitle: Everything here stays on this device.
teacher.empty: No codes yet. Paste some above.
teacher.clearConfirm: Remove every code stored on this device?
teacher.formOverrideHint: Paste the “Get pre-filled link” from your form — it carries both the address and the field id. A plain form address works too.
teacher.noNames: Students appear as class code + list number. This tool never sees a name.
teacher.formOverrideNoEntry: Saved the address, but no field id yet. Paste a pre-filled link so the code fills in by itself.
teacher.formOverrideBad: That does not look like a form link.
